routed_defects.title: receipt DIRECTORY symlink followed; no lstat on --dir, no lane/round provenance
routed_defects.remediation: lstatSync(dir).isSymbolicLink() -> SYMLINK_RECEIPT; require realpath(dir) under realpath(lane)

routed_defects.title: receipt read (and external instrument read) have no size cap; no entry-count cap
routed_defects.remediation: st.size > 1 MiB -> RECEIPT_UNREADABLE; statSync(abs).isFile() + size guard; cap entries

routed_defects.title: a RELATIVE cmd= token that resolves outside the lane is read from disk and counted external, though the contract licenses disk reads only for absolute instruments
routed_defects.remediation: in the non-absolute branch, lr.inside===false -> FailClosed('UNRESOLVED'); keep fromDisk only for isAbsolute tokens

routed_defects.title: duplicate cmd=/tool_sha256= is first-wins and undocumented; cmd= tail after the instrument is ignored (a receipt can display a pipeline that never ran and still read CLEAN)
routed_defects.remediation: state first-wins in the contract or fail closed on duplicates

routed_defects.title: tool_sha256= is lower-cased before validation, so an uppercase digest is silently accepted
routed_defects.remediation: document the leniency or require lowercase in FULL_SHA
